decision: Reject all tested cross-encoder policies; no safe recall gain and no production model/default/asset/dependency change.

model.preprocessing: BERT paired query/document encoding, max 512 tokens, longest-first truncation, single example without padding; raw classification logit, no sigmoid or pooling.
model.provenance: Official upstream float32 ONNX, pinned commit and LFS hash.

scope: Development-only frozen original/fresh/new cohorts; first 32 independently ranked eligible distinct MiniLM primary-index records. No gold insertion, altered queries, expected claims or labels.

limitations: Exposed synthetic retrieval cases with correlated queries per incident; no live-agent or extraction measurement.
New no-match labels are assistant-authored, not independent human precision judgments.
Published-logit compatibility covers two upstream examples, not comprehensive PyTorch numerical parity.
Admission only rescues empty results without files, so six nonempty baseline misses cannot improve in this family.
An additional conservative acceptance audit flags any newly added positive ID outside required source facts; labels never enter admission.
No historical or heldout candidate evaluation after development rejection.
Native packet previews and policy replay are not production dual-model latency measurements.
